source_text: Observational data and meta-analyses further indicate protective effects against human papillomavirus (HPV) and herpes simplex virus type 2 (HSV-2), with reductions of 30-35% for HPV and similar for HSV-2, though evidence for bacterial STIs like chlamydia and gonorrhea is weaker or absent. [103]
